name: Nuba

skills.name: Siphon of Souls
skills.description: Passively, at the start of battle, inflicts Crimson Doom Mark on the 3 farthest enemies. Every 2.5s, Crimson Doom Mark deals DMG equal to 15% of their current HP, capped at 240% of ATK, and destroys 50 Energy. When an enemy with Crimson Doom Mark falls, the mark does not disappear. Instead, it drains the target's essence and transforms into a Source of the Drought Devil at the target's location. Upon activation, inflicts Crimson Doom Mark on the nearest enemy, disabling them for 3 seconds, dealing 400% of ATK DMG, and absorbing 200 Energy.

upgrades.level3: Energy absorbed by the Active is increased to 300.

skills.name: Infernal Soulbreaker
skills.description: Deal 100% of ATK DMG to the nearest enemy and interrupt them. If the target has Crimson Doom Mark, this instead deals 300% of ATK DMG and stuns the target for 2s.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 120% of ATK and 320% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: If the target has Crimson Doom Mark, the Stun duration is increased to 3 seconds.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to 150% of ATK and 350% of ATK.

skills.name: Rite of Ashes
skills.description: Passively, heals for 50% of the DMG dealt by Nuba and Crimson Doom Mark. Converts any HP restored beyond Max HP into a shield. This shield cannot exceed 100% of Nuba's Max HP.

upgrades.level2: HP restored from DMG dealt by Nuba and Crimson Doom Mark is increased to 70%.
upgrades.level3: The shield cap is increased to 200% of Nuba's Max HP.
upgrades.level4: HP restored from DMG dealt by Nuba and Crimson Doom Mark is increased to 100%.

skills.name: Rise of the Drought
skills.description: When Nuba falls, she consumes one Source of the Drought Devil to revive at her current location, restoring 30% of her Max HP.

upgrades.level3: For each second the Source of the Drought Devil has existed, Nuba restores an additional 5% of Max HP upon revival.

relic.name: Curse of Decay
relic.description: Enemies infested with Crimson Doom Mark deal 25% less DMG. Each time Nuba casts her Ultimate, all enemies infested with Crimson Doom Mark permanently lose 15% ATK SPD, stacking up to 4 times.

upgrades.level2: For each Crimson Doom Mark on the battlefield, Nuba gains 15% DMG RED. This effect stacks.
upgrades.level3: Crimson Doom Mark deals DMG and destroys energy once every 1.5 seconds.
upgrades.level4: When reviving by consuming a Source of the Drought Devil, Nuba retains the Energy she had before she fell.

coreMechanic.summary: Off-tank sub-DPS with layered utility. Without dupe and relic investment she feeds enemy energy. Multiple non-obvious tricks in kit.

strengths: Applies Crimson Doom Mark at battle start passively — no ramp-up required for debuffing
Permanent ATK SPD reduction on marked enemies stacks up to 4× — grows more oppressive as the fight extends
Built-in self-revive through Drought Devil sources provides exceptional staying power
Energy drain/destruction on Ultimate can delay and disrupt enemy Ultimate rotations
Reliable Stun on Skill 1 against marked targets — near-100% CC uptime against tagged enemies
Passive lifesteal + overflow shield (Rite of Ashes) makes her self-sustaining once invested
Dual debuff coverage: DMG reduction + ATK SPD reduction simultaneously
weaknesses: At low dupe/relic investment, Doom Mark passive ticks can actually feed enemy Energy instead of draining it
Self-revive requires sources to exist — if marks expire before she dies, no revive token is available
Single-target focus on Ultimate active — mark re-application hits only the nearest enemy
No direct healing outside of the revive HP restore — vulnerable to sustained burst before marks expire
Utility-focused — needs supporting DPS; does not function as a standalone damage carry
